summary: China SXT Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 8,000,000 units at $1.50 per unit, each unit comprising one Class A ordinary share (or pre-funded warrant) and one ordinary warrant. Gross proceeds are approximately $12,000,000 before fees. Warrants have an initial exercise price of $2.75, exercisable immediately through the one-year anniversary, with cashless exercise and a zero exercise price option covering up to 72,000,000 shares. Univest Securities acted as placement agent for a 7.0% cash fee plus up to $50,000 in expenses. Investors hold a 30-day over-allotment option for up to $12,000,000 of additional securities. The offering closed October 9, 2026. Watch for warrant overhang and dilution risk.
